bug_summary: フロントエンドfallbackの判定がパス末尾セグメントの拡張子有無で誤判定しており、ドット付きパス(/users/john.doe等)がHTML要求でも誤って404になる
pr_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/routing.py b/fastapi/routing.py
index 28694b4e5..c442b122b 100644
--- a/fastapi/routing.py
+++ b/fastapi/routing.py
@@ -1984,13 +1984,24 @@ def _iter_accept_media_types(accept: str) -> Iterator[tuple[str, float]]:
 
 
 def _is_frontend_navigation_request(scope: Scope) -> bool:
+    route_path = get_route_path(scope)
+    final_segment = route_path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    if os.path.splitext(final_segment)[1]:
+        return False
     request = Request(scope)
+    wildcard_accepted = False
+    html_rejected = False
     for media_type, quality in _iter_accept_media_types(
         request.headers.get("accept", "")
     ):
-        if media_type in {"text/html", "application/xhtml+xml"} and quality != 0:
-            return True
-    return False
+        if media_type in {"text/html", "application/xhtml+xml"}:
+            if quality == 0:
+                html_rejected = True
+            else:
+                return True
+        elif media_type == "*/*" and quality != 0:
+            wildcard_accepted = True
+    return wildcard_accepted and not html_rejected
 
 
 class _FrontendRoute(BaseRoute):
pr_title: Improve frontend navigation detection for asset paths and wildcard Accept headers
pr_description: Extends _is_frontend_navigation_request to treat request paths whose final segment has a file extension as non-navigation, and to interpret `*/*` Accept headers alongside explicit `text/html` rejection (q=0) when deciding whether a request is a browser navigation.
